seating_geometry.notes: Independently verified on a copy of model/church_3000_concept.blend: exactly 3,000 mesh objects named SEAT-C-Rrr-Bb-Sss, all in 40_SEAT_Congregation, all flagged CountsTowardTarget=True, none hidden, no duplicate locations; 40 rows (R01-R02 = 56, R03-R40 = 76). All 3,000 seating_schedule.csv ids match the .blend (max position deviation 1.5e-6 m) and the IFC (3,000 IfcFurniture SeatType=congregation, max deviation 2e-6 m). Chair world size 0.48 x 0.60 x 0.85 m; 0 chair-chair overlaps; 0 mesh-level (BVH) intersections of any chair with 868 columns/walls/stairs/ramps/rails/beams/members/doors/lift/footings; row clearway 0.35 m everywhere; no columns inside the seating zone. Rake and C-values are generated by a recurrence (min C over n-1 = 0.060 m, rear rows also clear the wheelchair band). Deductions: C over n-2 is 0.1109-0.1164 in rows 4-6 against the 0.12 staggered target (logged SGT-02 WARN); 44.5 m maximum eye distance relies on unmodelled screens; rear section aisles are single 0.10-0.15 m risers on 0.95 m goings (non-uniform, logged OI-06). Builder's verifier is not a false positive: on a mutated copy (1 seat deleted, 1 seat shifted, 1 seat moved into a column) it reported 2999 seats, 3 clashes and aisle failures.

circulation_accessibility.notes: Represented: 5 main foyer doors, 10 hall exits (26.4 m total clear width, arithmetic checked), 1.5 m interior aisles and >=1.825 m wall aisles (checked from chair positions), 2.4 m mid cross aisle + 1.5 m wheelchair band, ambulatory ramps (steepest 1:13.17, flights <= 9 m), lift L00-L02, platform ramp 1:12, 30 wheelchair spaces + companions dispersed front/mid/rear, 4 foyer accessible WCs + BOH accessible WC. All dimensions labelled unverified. Weaknesses that bear on the single-level premise: max within-hall plan travel 53.3 m and 643 seats beyond the 30 m placeholder flag (geometry_checks.json metrics.egress); nearest-exit loading puts 1,006/1,032 people on each 2.4 m cross-aisle door (EGR-01N WARN) while exit_schedule.csv labels every exit 'OK' using only the queue-balanced heuristic; 1,104 rear occupants rely on four open (unenclosed) foyer stairs; the 8 rear wheelchair spaces at +3.84 (ACC-WCS-R2..R5) have only the lift as a step-free route and no refuge/assisted-evacuation provision is identified anywhere (no 'refuge' in reports/ or config/). Issues are honestly flagged with an explicit restriction on use in reports/open_issues.md, so not a critical blocker.

structural_concept.notes: Coherent, dimensioned grid A-H x 1-12 (IfcGrid with 8 U / 12 V axes). Verified in the .blend: 68 columns, all bottoms at -0.90 bearing on footing tops (0 unsupported), 26 columns reaching +14.00 (18 hall columns on B/G plus 8 gable posts), 9 Pratt trusses T3-T11 of 41 members each spanning 50 m at 8 m centres, roof bracing in bays 3-4/7-8/10-11, vertical bracing on B and G in bays 3-4 and 10-11 (no hall door in those bays), truss elevation drawn. Every member carries 'Space reservation only - not designed'; no capacities, loads or code claims found. Deductions: lateral concept relies on unverified portal moment knees plus gable bracing with no indication of which bays are moment-connected; X-bracing sits in the plane of a masonry infill wall (wall-member pairs excluded from the clash matrix); the four lift-core walls are typed IfcWall SHEAR although A-13 does not include the core in the lateral system; truss elements at +14 to +18.4 are contained in storey L03 (+5.75) while L05 'Hall truss bearing' contains nothing.

bim_semantics.notes: Independent ifcopenshell 0.8.5 check of a copy: IFC4, 0 schema/attribute issues, SI metre/m2/m3 units (scale 1.0), 1 project/site/building, 6 storeys, 0 uncontained elements, 42 openings with 42 fills/voids, sensible classes (IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcMember CHORD/PURLIN/BRACE, IfcElementAssembly TRUSS, IfcFooting PAD_FOOTING, IfcStair, IfcRamp, IfcDoor with OverallWidth attributes, IfcSpace with Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities, IfcSpatialZone for wheelchair/aisle/service zones), Pset_CA3000_Concept on all furniture with SeatType and CountsTowardTarget, discipline prefixes and collection property. Deductions: storey L05 (+14.00) is empty and all roof trusses/purlins/bracing (placement z 16-17.6) are contained in L03 (+5.75); no IfcMaterial or material associations at all; no element quantity sets (only spaces), so beams/columns/slabs carry no Qto; lift walls typed SHEAR; the builder's IFC-STOREYS check passes without testing element-to-storey elevation consistency.

parametric_reproduction.notes: Reviewer re-ran scripts/build_auditorium.py from copies of scripts/ and config/ in headless Blender 5.2.3: BUILD_SUMMARY 4,599 exported objects, 3,000 seats, manifest SHA-256 d15f62e1... identical to model/blender_manifest.json. Unit tests (17) re-run from a copy: all pass, including a parametric change test (3,040 seats) and target-mismatch guard. All source/output SHA-256 values in reports/model_revision.json re-hashed and match; archive/iteration-01 is byte-identical to current outputs. Environment documented. Minor: IFC export takes ~78 s and is driven from the manifest rather than the .blend itself (consistency nevertheless confirmed by reviewer seat/position checks).

documentation.notes: Plans are legible, gridded, dimensioned (bay dims, 59 m / 88 m overall, scale bar, assumed north), carry revision and 'CONCEPT - UNVERIFIED' title blocks, label exits with width/load, levels, rows and spaces with areas; long section shows rake, focal point and C-values; structural grid shows column/pad placeholders and truss elevation. Reports cite the correct revision and match model numbers checked (26.4 m exit width, 44.5 m eye distance, 1:10.56 slope, 68 columns, 9 trusses). Deductions: space_schedule.csv areas overlap/double count (SP-08 booth inside SP-07 upper foyer; SP-09 lift inside SP-06) and leave areas under the upper foyer at x<5 and x>54 unassigned; A-05 states wall aisles >= 1.70 m while basis_of_design.md and CIR-02 give 1.825 m; exit_schedule.csv placeholder_check reports 'OK' for all exits without the nearest-exit result; Option B (balcony) is only a tabulated estimate with no sketch section or sightline check.

validation_traceability.notes: Logs exist for every pipeline stage with commands and exit codes; seat count cross-checked across layout, .blend reopen, IFC and CSV; clash detector has positive/negative controls and the reviewer's mutation test confirmed it fails correctly; open issues and assumptions carry source/status/confidence; no invented standards references or compliance claims found in reports or IFC strings. Deductions: Egress.test_balanced_widths_meet_placeholder is close to self-fulfilling (the balancing algorithm assigns occupants against door capacity, so it cannot detect a real shortfall); IFC-STOREYS passes despite elements being contained in the wrong storey; clash matrix omits wall-member and wall-stair pairs; no check exists for refuge/assisted evacuation of upper-level wheelchair positions or for space-schedule overlaps.

findings.issue: Within-hall travel and exit distribution undermine the single-level premise: max plan travel 53.3 m, 643 seats beyond the 30 m placeholder flag, and nearest-exit loading of 1,006/1,032 persons on each 2.4 m mid cross-aisle door; exit_schedule.csv nevertheless labels every exit 'OK' using only the queue-balanced heuristic.
findings.evidence: reports/geometry_checks.json (EGR-01N WARN, EGR-03 53.27, metrics.egress.count_travel_hall_over_flag=643); reports/exit_schedule.csv (load_nearest_exit 1006/1032 vs placeholder_check OK); exports/floor_plan.png
findings.fix: Model and test at least one mitigation in the layout engine (e.g. vomitories through the rear rake at row ~30, additional exits through platform wings/stage rear, or widened cross-aisle doors/landings), re-run travel metrics, and add a nearest-exit placeholder_check column (and a combined worst-case status) to exit_schedule.csv instead of reporting only the balanced result.

findings.issue: Eight rear wheelchair spaces (and companions) at +3.84 have the lift as their only step-free route out; no refuge area, protected lobby or assisted-evacuation provision is identified in model or reports, and the 1,104 rear occupants descend four open, unenclosed foyer stairs.
findings.evidence: reports/accessible_positions.csv (ACC-WCS-R2-01..R5-02, floor 3.84); exports/upper_foyer_plan.png (STAIR-FOYER-1..4 open in foyer); no occurrence of 'refuge' in reports/ or config/auditorium_params.json
findings.fix: Add an IfcSpace/IfcSpatialZone refuge allowance at each upper-foyer stair head (or relocate rear wheelchair spaces to a level reached by ramp), state the open-stair vs protected-stair assumption in assumptions.md, add an open issue for fire-engineer review, and add a check that every wheelchair position has a step-free exit route or a refuge.

findings.issue: IFC storey containment is wrong for the roof structure: storey L05 'Hall truss bearing' (+14.00) contains no elements, while all 9 truss assemblies, chords, purlins and roof bracing (placement z 16-17.6 m) are contained in L03 (+5.75 'Low roofs'). The builder's IFC-STOREYS check passes because it only tests that storeys exist.
findings.fix: Assign storey by element base elevation in scripts/auditorium_layout.py / export_ifc.py (trusses, purlins, roof bracing and hall roof to L05), and add a validator check that each element's placement z lies between its storey elevation and the next storey (with documented exceptions for footings and raked seating).

findings.issue: Rear-section aisles use a single 0.10-0.15 m riser per 0.95 m going, varying row by row, over 21 rows used as egress by ~1,600 people; combined with the 0.18 m riser at the cross-aisle mouths this is a trip-hazard geometry that is logged (OI-06/OI-07) but not resolved or optioned.
findings.fix: Either regularise risers (e.g. two equal risers per row or constant rise per row band with adjusted C-value check) or convert rear aisles to sloped aisles within the placeholder gradient; model the aisle steps explicitly and add a riser-uniformity check.

findings.issue: No materials and no element quantities in the IFC: 0 IfcMaterial / IfcRelAssociatesMaterial; IfcElementQuantity exists only for the 23 spaces.
findings.fix: Associate placeholder materials (e.g. 'Steel - grade TBC', 'Masonry - TBC', 'Concrete - TBC') and write Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities/Qto_BeamBaseQuantities/Qto_SlabBaseQuantities/Qto_WallBaseQuantities from the manifest geometry.

findings.issue: Lift-core walls are typed IfcWall SHEAR although the lateral concept (A-13) does not use the core; X-bracing on grids B/G lies in the plane of masonry infill walls and wall-member pairs are excluded from the clash matrix.
findings.evidence: reviews/iteration-01-work/ifc_schema_validate.log (shear walls ARC-WALL-LIFT-*); scripts/verify_blend.py clash rules; exports/structural_grid.png (VB bays)
findings.fix: Retype lift walls as SOLIDWALL (or add the core to A-13 explicitly), and either model braced bays as open/clad bays or add a wall-brace coordination note and clash rule.

findings.issue: Space schedule double-counts/overlaps and leaves gaps: booth (SP-08) inside upper foyer (SP-07), lift (SP-09) inside SP-06; L00 areas under the upper foyer at x<5 and x>54 are unassigned.
findings.fix: Make spaces non-overlapping per level (net areas) or add a gross/net column, and add a check that spaces on each level do not overlap.

findings.issue: Internal inconsistency: assumptions register A-05 says wall aisles >= 1.70 m, while basis_of_design.md and check CIR-02 report 1.825 m (criterion 1.5 m).
findings.fix: Generate A-05 text from the same computed value/criterion used by CIR-02.

findings.issue: Self-fulfilling test: Egress.test_balanced_widths_meet_placeholder asserts the queue-balanced assignment fits door capacities, which the balancing algorithm is designed to achieve; it cannot detect under-provision.
findings.fix: Replace with a test on an independent criterion (total width vs total demand, largest-exit-blocked, and nearest-exit loads) and add a negative test that removes an exit and expects failure.

findings.issue: Option B (floor + balcony) comparison is a tabulated estimate only, with no sketch section or sightline/egress check, and C over n-2 is below the 0.12 m staggered target in rows 4-6.
findings.fix: Add a schematic Option B long section generated from balcony_option parameters with C-values, and either adjust front-row elevations or document acceptance of the n-2 shortfall.

reviewer_summary: Iteration 1 (first review; no previous iteration to compare for regressions). This evaluates concept engineering-coordination model quality only; it does not certify safety, code compliance or construction readiness. The model is real, reproducible and internally consistent: the reviewer independently counted exactly 3,000 congregation seats in a copy of the .blend and in the IFC, matched every id/position to seating_schedule.csv, found no seat clashes at mesh level, reproduced the Blender manifest byte-identically, re-ran all 17 unit tests, schema-validated the IFC4 file (0 issues), confirmed output hashes and showed the builder's verifier catches injected faults. No fabricated calculations, compliance or approval claims were found, so there are no critical blockers. The score is held below the acceptance threshold mainly by circulation: 53 m in-hall travel with 643 seats beyond the placeholder flag, nearest-exit overload of the cross-aisle doors, no refuge for upper-level wheelchair users, and irregular rear aisle steps; plus IFC storey misassignment of the roof structure, missing materials/quantities and some schedule inconsistencies. Status: NOT_ACCEPTED_FOR_THIS_MILESTONE.
